inbox.selectTaskHint: Select a task from the list to claim it or open its form.
inbox.claimHint: This task is available to your group. Claim it to open and complete its form.

notfound.title: Page not found

settings.selectSettingHint: Choose a configuration entity on the left to manage it here.
settings.missingWarning: {{app}} does not provide: {{missing}} - falls back to the default language.
settings.rlDescription: One preference for the whole stack: the user interface, the data and document printing all follow the selected language. Content a module has not translated yet falls back to the default language.
settings.formatsHint: Patterns for dates, timestamps and numbers across all applications. The number pattern sets the grouping and decimal separators; each field keeps its own number of decimals.
settings.tenantConfigHint: Per-tenant overrides for the predefined branding properties. Leave a value empty to fall back to the platform default.
settings.tenantConfigForbidden: You do not have permission to view or change the tenant configuration.
settings.tenantConfigFailed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
settings.numberingHint: Each document series' prefix, total width and next value for this tenant. A number is the prefix plus the sequence zero-padded to the total width; sequences run continuously - to restart numbering (e.g. each January), set the prefix and the next value here.
settings.numberingForbidden: You do not have permission to view or change document numbering.
settings.numberingFailed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
settings.numberingEmpty: No number series declared yet. A series appears here once a published application declares it.
settings.numberingShapeTemplate: Counters live on the per-partition rows below; a new partition appears on its first use, inheriting this shape and its starting counter.
